usage.desc: A linear gradient with no native dependency. React Native has none across Expo SDK 54–57, so this composes one out of bands.
The stops, in order. One colour paints flat; each consecutive pair becomes its own segment.
vertical, horizontal, diagonal or diagonal-reverse. Diagonals rotate a √2 plane, so no measuring is involved.
Bands per segment. More is smoother and heavier in the view tree; 48 is the default and enough for most surfaces.
Content sits above the gradient and stays tappable — the gradient never takes the touch.

colors.description: Gradient stops. One alone paints flat; none paints nothing.

direction.description:
'vertical' runs top to bottom, 'horizontal' left to right,
'diagonal' top-left to bottom-right and 'diagonal-reverse' top-right
to bottom-left.

steps.description:
Bands per segment (a segment = a pair of consecutive colours). More bands
= smoother transition and more views in the tree.
